newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan seizes more than tonne of hashish.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan seizes more than tonne of hashish.

text.p: Pakistan customs officials have seized more than a tonne of hashish being brought from neighbouring Afghanistan for shipment to Europe, customs sources said on Friday.

The drug, weighing 1,340 kg (2,955 lb), was found on Thursday in a tanker-truck being driven through the border town of Chaman in the southwest province of Baluchistan, of which Quetta is the capital.
Officials arrested one man for trying to smuggle in the drug, which was packed inside the tanker in plastic bags of one kg (2.2 lb) each, the sources said.
